import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    xs = [0] * (n + 1)
    ys = [0] * (n + 1)
    idx = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        xs[i] = data[idx]
        ys[i] = data[idx + 1]
        idx += 2

    SHIFT = 11
    MASK = (1 << SHIFT) - 1
    LSHIFT = 2 * SHIFT
    total = n * n
    edges = [0] * total
    p = 0

    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        x = xs[v]
        y = ys[v]
        length = x * x + y * y
        edges[p] = (length << LSHIFT) | v
        p += 1

    for u in range(1, n + 1):
        xu = xs[u]
        yu = ys[u]
        ucode = u << SHIFT
        for v in range(1, u):
            dx = xu - xs[v]
            dy = yu - ys[v]
            length = dx * dx + dy * dy
            edges[p] = (length << LSHIFT) | ucode | v
            p += 1
        for v in range(u + 1, n + 1):
            dx = xu - xs[v]
            dy = yu - ys[v]
            length = dx * dx + dy * dy
            edges[p] = (length << LSHIFT) | ucode | v
            p += 1

    edges.sort(reverse=True)

    NEG = -10**9
    best = [NEG] * (n + 1)
    upd = [NEG] * (n + 1)
    touched = []
    ans = 0

    e = edges
    b = best
    up = upd
    i = 0

    while i < total:
        L = e[i] >> LSHIFT
        j = i
        while j < total and (e[j] >> LSHIFT) == L:
            key = e[j]
            u = (key >> SHIFT) & MASK
            v = key & MASK

            if u == 0:
                val = 1
            else:
                bu = b[u]
                if bu < 0:
                    j += 1
                    continue
                val = bu + 1

            if val > up[v]:
                if up[v] == NEG:
                    touched.append(v)
                up[v] = val
                if val > ans:
                    ans = val
            j += 1

        for v in touched:
            uv = up[v]
            if uv > b[v]:
                b[v] = uv
            up[v] = NEG
        touched.clear()
        i = j

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
